NBE Governor Holds Bilateral Meeting with Reserve Bank of India Governor

The Governor of the National Bank of Ethiopia, H.E. Dr. Eyob Tekalign, held a productive bilateral meeting with the Governor of the Reserve Bank of India, Mr. Sanjay Malhotra, on the sidelines of the BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting in Mumbai.

The two Governors exchanged views on opportunities for collaboration between Ethiopia and India, particularly in the financial and banking sectors.

They agreed to establish a joint technical team to identify and explore feasible areas of cooperation and further strengthen financial sector ties between the two countries.

NBEthiopia
Additionally, the Governor welcomed progress on the Contingent Reserve Arrangement (CRA) Treaty amendments aimed at strengthening the framework as a robust financial safety net. He urged that the onboarding process for new members explicitly consider each country’s stage of development, financial needs, and absorption capacity.

Dr. Eyob reaffirmed Ethiopia’s dedication to the group’s shared vision, emphasizing the nation’s readiness to collaborate constructively in advancing its strategic priorities.

Ethiopia Reaffirms Reform Momentum and BRICS Commitment at Second FMCBG Meeting

The Ethiopian delegation, led by National Bank of Ethiopia Governor H.E. Eyob Tekalign (PhD), participated in the Second BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) Meeting in Mumbai, India, hosted under the Indian Chairship’s theme, “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.”

Addressing the key challenges and opportunities facing BRICS economies, Dr. Eyob highlighted that Ethiopia’s comprehensive fiscal, monetary, financial sector, and exchange rate reforms continue to strengthen macroeconomic stability and financial resilience amid a volatile global economic landscape that disproportionately impacts developing nations.

National Bank of Ethiopia Governor Holds Bilateral Meeting with NDB President

On the sidelines of the BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting, H.E. Dr. Eyob Tekalign, Governor of the National Bank of Ethiopia, met with H.E. Dilma Rousseff, President of the New Development Bank (NDB).

The meeting offered a key opportunity to discuss shared priorities and explore ways to deepen cooperation between Ethiopia and the NDB, particularly in support of the country’s national development agenda and ongoing economic transformation.

This bilateral exchange follows the Ethiopian Council of Ministers’ recent approval of the country’s NDB membership, which has now been referred to Parliament for final ratification.
